proposed_comments.title: Keep a failed refresh from replacing the healthy details graph
proposed_comments.body:
### Keep a failed refresh from replacing the healthy details graph

**Severity:** high

ReplaceDetails still swaps in a replacement DetailsViewModel before the refresh has fully initialized. If that replacement throws, the list item can discard a previously healthy details graph and leave stale UI state behind. Keep the existing details alive when a replacement refresh fails, clean up only the replacement, and retain the current item state unless the refresh truly owns the new selection.

confidence.rationale: The live ListItemViewModel path still swaps the details instance before initialization completes, and the review history identifies failed-refresh cleanup as the remaining lifecycle bug.

proposed_comments.title: Guard stale selection publication against newer UI work
proposed_comments.body:
### Guard stale selection publication against newer UI work

**Severity:** high

SetSelectedItemAsync waits for SafeSlowInitAsync() and then emits ShowDetailsMessage and UpdateSuggestionMessage without a generation check at the exact UI publication point. A rapidly reselected item can still finish an older async init and overwrite the newer selection, leaving stale details or suggestions behind. Re-check the current selection generation and cancellation at the actual publication point, and only emit those UI updates for the still-live selection.

confidence.rationale: The live selection path still publishes UI work after an async slow-init completes, and the review history identifies stale publication as the second remaining lifecycle race.
